links.outcome: Macro F1 of zero-shot LLMs versus supervised models on the same pathology report classification tasks
links.effect: GPT-4 performed either significantly better than or as well as the best supervised model, LSTM-Att (average macro F1 0.86 vs 0.75); other LLMs performed poorly.
links.quote: Across all 12 tasks, the GPT-4 model performed either significantly better than or as well as the best supervised model, LSTM-Att (average macro F1-score of 0.86 vs 0.75), with advantage on tasks with high label imbalance.

unlisted_practices: Using zero-shot LLM classification to reduce the need for large annotated datasets in clinical NLP

screen.reason: Evaluates and benchmarks zero-shot LLM performance against traditional supervised models on information extraction from breast cancer pathology reports, without evaluating a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
